name: heart
description: A balanced heart with full lobes and a softened lower point in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Filled upper lobes and center notch are fitted to the visible exterior of the original Outline at Regular stroke 1.70 (0.85-unit outward normal offset). Offset branches are trimmed at the symmetric center intersection, with cubic segments fitted to within 0.001 drawing unit. The lower slim V and slight outward bow remain as authored. Bounds x=2.4..21.6, y=3.25..20.75 remain centered. No interior counters or strokes. Owner-approved source. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Established centerline proportions and pose are retained. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved every current static icon, style and supported frame on 2026-10-27. Motion approval is separate.

reviewHistory.note: Owner approved Heart Outline and Filled after the head alignment and centered-grid review. The reviewed Lab preview used X/Y=95%; these local preview settings are recorded without changing the source geometry.
